body.condition: Before stage-1 treatment assignment, \(\{H_{n,s}(\rho):s\in S\}\) is drawn independently of the fixed baseline array \(B\), independently across strata, and uniformly over subsets of \(\{1,\ldots,N_{n1s}\}\) of size \(\lfloor\rho N_{n1s}\rfloor\).

standard.name: independent stratified simple random sampling without replacement
